name: Chest Pain with Breathlessness
message: Co-occurring chest pain and breathlessness reported. Requires urgent cardiac and pulmonary clinical evaluation.

name: Severe or Progressive Breathlessness
message: High severity or progressive respiratory distress reported (severity >= 7/10 or severe/கடுமையான). Clinician must assess airway patency and respiratory effort immediately.

name: Sudden Severe Headache
message: Sudden onset severe headache ('thunderclap') reported. Clinician must rule out acute intracranial vascular pathology or hemorrhage.

name: Fever with Meningism / Neurological Signs
message: Fever combined with neck stiffness or acute neurological changes. Urgent screening for central nervous system infection (meningitis / encephalitis) required.

name: Acute Severe Abdominal Pain
message: Severe acute abdominal pain (severity >= 8/10) reported. Requires urgent physical evaluation to exclude surgical acute abdomen or perforation.

name: Focal Neurological Deficit
message: Focal neurological deficit reported. Urgent stroke assessment (FAST protocol) and immediate clinical triage required.

name: Airway Compromise / Anaphylaxis
message: Potential upper airway obstruction or acute anaphylaxis reported. Immediate clinical evaluation of airway patency required.

name: Prolonged Persistent Fever (> 7 days)
message: Persistent fever duration exceeding 7 days reported without clear etiology. Comprehensive diagnostic clinical workup recommended.

name: Active Bleeding / Hemoptysis
message: Active respiratory or gastrointestinal bleeding reported. Immediate clinical assessment of hemodynamic stability required.

name: Discordant or Unverified Respiratory Status
message: Breathlessness reported by patient but visual vitals cannot confirm or are discordant. Video cannot rule out respiratory compromise; direct clinician assessment required.
